solver_sql: SELECT MAX(loser_id) as loser_id, AVG(avg_ht) as avg_height, SUM(cnt) as total_cnt, AVG(CAST(cnt AS REAL) / 278.0) as avg_ratio FROM (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(loser_ht) as avg_ht, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matches WHERE loser_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand) GROUP BY loser_hand

SELECT winner_hand, AVG(age_diff) as age_diff_avg, SUM(cnt) as cnt_sum, CAST(SUM(cnt)) / (SELECT SUM(cnt_sum) FROM (SELECT winner_hand, SUM(cnt_val) as cnt_sum FROM (SELECT winner_id, winner_hand, COUNT(*) as cnt_val FROM matches WHERE winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id, winner_hand) GROUP BY winner_hand)) as cnt_ratio FROM (SELECT winner_id, winner_hand, AVG(loser_age - winner_age) as age_diff, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matches WHERE winner_id IS NOT NULL AND loser_age IS NOT NULL AND winner_age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id, winner_hand) GROUP BY winner_hand

SELECT loser_hand, hand_value, hand_value - G as difference, hand_value - B as diff_from_B FROM matches m JOIN (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_age) as hand_value FROM (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(loser_age) as avg_age FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND loser_age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand) GROUP BY loser_hand) hv ON m.loser_hand = hv.loser_hand, (SELECT AVG(hand_value) as G FROM (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_age) as hand_value FROM (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(loser_age) as avg_age FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND loser_age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand) GROUP BY loser_hand)) g_calc, (SELECT AVG(hand_value) as B FROM (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_age) as hand_value FROM (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(loser_age) as avg_age FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND loser_age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand) GROUP BY loser_hand) WHERE hand_value > (SELECT AVG(hand_value) FROM (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_age) as hand_value FROM (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(loser_age) as avg_age FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND loser_age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand) GROUP BY loser_hand))) b_calc WHERE hv.hand_value > g_calc.G

SELECT AVG(avg_rp) as avg_of_averages, AVG(D1) as avg_D1, AVG(D2) as avg_D2 FROM (SELECT player_id, avg_rp, D1, avg_rp - B as D2 FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_rp FROM rankings WHERE ranking_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id) p1, (SELECT AVG(avg_rp) as G FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_rp FROM rankings WHERE ranking_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id)) g_calc, (SELECT AVG(avg_rp) as B FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_rp FROM rankings WHERE ranking_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id) WHERE AVG(ranking_points) IS NOT NULL AND player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM rankings WHERE ranking_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id HAVING AVG(ranking_points) > (SELECT AVG(avg_rp) FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_rp FROM rankings WHERE ranking_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id)))) b_calc, (SELECT avg_rp - G as D1 FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_rp FROM rankings WHERE ranking_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id) p1, (SELECT AVG(avg_rp) as G FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_rp FROM rankings WHERE ranking_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id)) g_calc WHERE avg_rp > g_calc.G) d1_calc WHERE avg_rp > g_calc.G AND avg_rp > b_calc.B)

SELECT AVG(country_avg) as avg_of_averages, AVG(D1) as avg_D1, AVG(D2) as avg_D2 FROM (SELECT loser_ioc, country_avg, D1, country_avg - B as D2 FROM (SELECT loser_ioc, AVG(winner_ht) as country_avg FROM matches WHERE winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_ioc) c1, (SELECT AVG(country_avg) as G FROM (SELECT loser_ioc, AVG(winner_ht) as country_avg FROM matches WHERE winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_ioc)) g_calc, (SELECT AVG(country_avg) as B FROM (SELECT loser_ioc, AVG(winner_ht) as country_avg FROM matches WHERE winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_ioc) WHERE loser_ioc IN (SELECT loser_ioc FROM matches WHERE winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_ioc HAVING AVG(winner_ht) > (SELECT AVG(country_avg) FROM (SELECT loser_ioc, AVG(winner_ht) as country_avg FROM matches WHERE winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_ioc)) AND AVG(winner_ht) > (SELECT AVG(country_avg) FROM (SELECT loser_ioc, AVG(winner_ht) as country_avg FROM matches WHERE winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_ioc) WHERE loser_ioc IN (SELECT loser_ioc FROM matches WHERE winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_ioc HAVING AVG(winner_ht) > (SELECT AVG(country_avg) FROM (SELECT loser_ioc, AVG(winner_ht) as country_avg FROM matches WHERE winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_ioc)))))) b_calc WHERE country_avg > g_calc.G AND country_avg > b_calc.B)

SELECT SUM(C) as total_C, AVG(R) as avg_R, AVG(R_minus_AR) as avg_R_minus_AR FROM (SELECT winner_id, C, C * 1.0 / T as R, C * 1.0 / T - AR as R_minus_AR FROM (SELECT winner_id, COUNT(*) as C FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id) p1, (SELECT SUM(cnt) as T FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id)) t_calc, (SELECT AVG(C * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id))) as AR FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as C FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id)) ar_calc WHERE C * 1.0 / t_calc.T > ar_calc.AR)

SELECT loser_hand, hand_value, hand_value - G as difference, hand_value - B as diff_from_B FROM matches m JOIN (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_ht) as hand_value FROM (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(winner_ht) as avg_ht FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand) GROUP BY loser_hand) hv ON m.loser_hand = hv.loser_hand, (SELECT AVG(hand_value) as G FROM (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_ht) as hand_value FROM (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(winner_ht) as avg_ht FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand) GROUP BY loser_hand)) g_calc, (SELECT AVG(hand_value) as B FROM (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_ht) as hand_value FROM (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(winner_ht) as avg_ht FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand) GROUP BY loser_hand) WHERE hand_value > (SELECT AVG(hand_value) FROM (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_ht) as hand_value FROM (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(winner_ht) as avg_ht FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand) GROUP BY loser_hand))) b_calc WHERE hv.hand_value > g_calc.G

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.winner_rank_points) as avg_pts FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_pts) as avg_by_hand FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.hand, s1.avg_pts, s1.avg_pts - s2.avg_by_hand as diff FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.hand = s2.hand WHERE s1.avg_pts > s2.avg_by_hand), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) as overall_avg FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.winner_id, s3.hand, s3.avg_pts, s3.diff, s3.avg_pts - s4.overall_avg as diff2 FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s3.avg_pts > s4.overall_avg) SELECT hand, AVG(avg_pts), AVG(diff), AVG(diff2) FROM step5 GROUP BY hand

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_rank_points) as avg_pts FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.hand, s1.avg_pts, s1.avg_pts - s2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_pts > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_pts) as avg_by_hand FROM step3 GROUP BY hand), step5 AS (SELECT s3.winner_id, s3.hand, s3.avg_pts, s3.diff, s3.avg_pts - s4.avg_by_hand as diff2 FROM step3 s3 JOIN step4 s4 ON s3.hand = s4.hand WHERE s3.avg_pts > s4.avg_by_hand) SELECT hand, AVG(avg_pts), AVG(diff), AVG(diff2) FROM step5 GROUP BY hand

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.draw_size) as avg_draw FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_draw) as avg_by_hand FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_by_hand) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.hand, s2.avg_by_hand, s2.avg_by_hand - s3.overall_avg as diff FROM step2 s2 CROSS JOIN step3 s3 WHERE s3.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s2.avg_by_hand > s3.overall_avg), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_by_hand) as avg_step4 FROM step4) SELECT s4.hand, s4.avg_by_hand, s4.diff, s4.avg_by_hand - s5.avg_step4 FROM step4 s4 CROSS JOIN step5 s5 WHERE s5.avg_step4 IS NOT NULL AND s4.avg_by_hand > s5.avg_step4

WITH S1 AS (
  SELECT 
    m.winner_id,
    p.hand,
    AVG(CAST(m.winner_age AS FLOAT)) as avg_winner_age,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN m.loser_rank_points > 0 
        THEN CAST(m.winner_rank_points - m.loser_rank_points) / CAST(m.loser_rank_points AS FLOAT)
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) as avg_ratio
  FROM matches m
  INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.hand IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_age IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand
),
S2 AS (
  SELECT 
    hand,
    AVG(avg_winner_age) as avg_winner_age,
    AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM S1
  GROUP BY hand
),
G AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_winner_age) as global_avg
  FROM S2
)
SELECT 
  S2.hand,
  S2.avg_winner_age,
  S2.avg_ratio,
  S2.avg_winner_age - G.global_avg
FROM S2, G
WHERE S2.avg_winner_age > G.global_avg

WITH H AS (
  SELECT 
    p.hand,
    AVG(CAST(m.winner_age AS FLOAT)) as avg_winner_age,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN m.loser_rank_points > 0 
        THEN CAST(m.winner_rank_points - m.loser_rank_points) / CAST(m.loser_rank_points AS FLOAT)
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) as avg_ratio
  FROM matches m
  INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.hand IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_age IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.hand
),
G AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_winner_age) as global_avg
  FROM H
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    H.avg_winner_age,
    H.avg_ratio,
    H.avg_winner_age - G.global_avg as diff
  FROM H, G
  WHERE H.avg_winner_age > G.global_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_winner_age),
  AVG(avg_ratio),
  AVG(diff)
FROM filtered

SELECT winner_hand, AVG(step1.avg_diff) as avg_step1_col3, AVG(step1.ratio) as avg_step1_col4 FROM (SELECT m.winner_id, m.winner_hand, AVG(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) as avg_diff, AVG(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) / (SELECT AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) FROM matches m2 WHERE m2.winner_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM players)) as ratio FROM matches m WHERE m.winner_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM players) GROUP BY m.winner_id, m.winner_hand) step1 GROUP BY winner_hand

SELECT loser_id, avg_diff, avg_diff - (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) FROM (SELECT AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as avg_diff FROM matches GROUP BY loser_id)) as diff FROM (SELECT loser_id, AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as avg_diff FROM matches GROUP BY loser_id) WHERE avg_diff > (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) FROM (SELECT AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as avg_diff FROM matches GROUP BY loser_id)) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH player_ages AS (SELECT loser_id, AVG(CASE WHEN loser_age IS NOT NULL AND winner_age IS NOT NULL THEN loser_age - winner_age END) AS player_avg FROM matches WHERE loser_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(player_avg) AS overall_avg FROM player_ages WHERE player_avg IS NOT NULL), kept_players AS (SELECT pa.loser_id, pa.player_avg, pa.player_avg - oa.overall_avg AS D FROM player_ages pa, overall_avg oa WHERE pa.player_avg > oa.overall_avg), M_avg AS (SELECT AVG(D) AS M FROM kept_players WHERE D IS NOT NULL) SELECT kp.loser_id AS player_id, kp.player_avg, kp.D, CASE WHEN ma.M IS NOT NULL AND ma.M != 0 THEN kp.D / ma.M ELSE NULL END AS D_div_M FROM kept_players kp, M_avg ma WHERE ma.M IS NOT NULL ORDER BY D_div_M IS NULL, D_div_M DESC LIMIT 10

WITH group1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(CASE WHEN m.loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL THEN m.loser_rank_points END) AS R, AVG(CASE WHEN m.winner_ht IS NOT NULL AND m.loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND m.loser_ht > 0 THEN CAST(m.winner_ht AS FLOAT) / m.loser_ht END) AS Q FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), group2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(CASE WHEN R IS NOT NULL THEN R END) AS R2, AVG(CASE WHEN Q IS NOT NULL THEN Q END) AS Q2 FROM group1 GROUP BY hand), G_val AS (SELECT AVG(R2) AS G FROM group2 WHERE R2 IS NOT NULL), kept_hands AS (SELECT g2.hand, g2.R2, g2.Q2, g2.R2 - gv.G AS D FROM group2 g2, G_val gv WHERE g2.R2 > gv.G) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN R2 IS NOT NULL THEN R2 END) AS avg_R2, AVG(CASE WHEN Q2 IS NOT NULL THEN Q2 END) AS avg_Q2, AVG(CASE WHEN D IS NOT NULL THEN D END) AS avg_D FROM kept_hands

WITH stage1 AS (SELECT m.loser_id, p.hand, AVG(CASE WHEN m.winner_age IS NOT NULL THEN m.winner_age END) AS col3, AVG(CASE WHEN m.loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_rank_points > 0 THEN CAST(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) / m.winner_rank_points END) AS col4 FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.loser_id WHERE m.loser_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand), stage2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(CASE WHEN col3 IS NOT NULL THEN col3 END) AS col2, AVG(CASE WHEN col4 IS NOT NULL THEN col4 END) AS col3 FROM stage1 GROUP BY hand), stage3 AS (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN col2 IS NOT NULL THEN col2 END) AS col1 FROM stage2), stage4 AS (SELECT s2.hand AS col1, s2.col2 AS col2, s2.col3 AS col3, s2.col2 - s3.col1 AS col4 FROM stage2 s2, stage3 s3 WHERE s3.col1 IS NOT NULL AND s2.col2 > s3.col1) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN col2 IS NOT NULL THEN col2 END) AS avg_col2, AVG(CASE WHEN col3 IS NOT NULL THEN col3 END) AS avg_col3, AVG(CASE WHEN col4 IS NOT NULL THEN col4 END) AS avg_col4 FROM stage4

WITH stage1 AS (SELECT winner_id, AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as avg_rank_diff FROM matches WHERE loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id), stage2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rank_diff) as overall_avg FROM stage1), stage3 AS (SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.avg_rank_diff, s1.avg_rank_diff - s2.overall_avg as diff_from_overall FROM stage1 s1 CROSS JOIN stage2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_rank_diff > s2.overall_avg), stage4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rank_diff) as avg_of_stage3 FROM stage3) SELECT s3.winner_id, s3.avg_rank_diff, s3.diff_from_overall, s3.avg_rank_diff / s4.avg_of_stage3 as final_ratio FROM stage3 s3 CROSS JOIN stage4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_of_stage3 IS NOT NULL AND s3.avg_rank_diff > s4.avg_of_stage3 ORDER BY final_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.loser_id, m.loser_hand, AVG(m.winner_rank_points) as avg_winner_rank FROM matches m WHERE m.loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.loser_id, m.loser_hand), step2 AS (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_winner_rank) as hand_avg_rank FROM step1 GROUP BY loser_hand), step3 AS (SELECT step1.loser_id, step1.loser_hand, step1.avg_winner_rank, step1.avg_winner_rank - step2.hand_avg_rank as diff FROM step1 INNER JOIN step2 ON step1.loser_hand = step2.loser_hand WHERE step1.avg_winner_rank > step2.hand_avg_rank), step4 AS (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_winner_rank) as avg_winner_rank, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step3 GROUP BY loser_hand), step5_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_winner_rank) as overall_avg FROM step4), step5 AS (SELECT step4.loser_hand, step4.avg_winner_rank, step4.avg_diff, step4.avg_winner_rank - step5_val.overall_avg as final_diff FROM step4, step5_val WHERE step5_val.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND step4.avg_winner_rank > step5_val.overall_avg) SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_winner_rank) as result1, AVG(avg_diff) as result2, AVG(final_diff) as result3 FROM step5 GROUP BY loser_hand
